note: MERGE_CANDIDATE is deliberately not a terminal class. Section 010 makes canonicalConvergence true only when every valuable unique contribution reaches one of the five terminal classes, so a branch parked here keeps softwareOpen above zero. That is the point: it records that work is wanted without letting wanting it count as having done it.
